ar: فكر بعض طلاب الجامعة في فكرة ذكية لبناء منزل خاص.
en: Some college students had an intelligent idea to build a special house.
questions: What did the students want to build?
Was their idea simple or intelligent?

ar: كان الهدف بناء منزل حديث يستخدم كمية قليلة من الطاقة.
en: They wanted to build a modern house that uses a small amount of energy.
questions: What was the goal of the house?
Did it use a lot of energy?

ar: المنزل يستخدم الطاقة الشمسية للحرارة والكهرباء.
en: The house uses solar energy for heat and power.
questions: What type of energy does the house use?
Is it renewable energy?

ar: المنزل صديق للبيئة ويسمى المنزل الأخضر.
en: The house is green, meaning it is friendly to the environment.
questions: Why is it called a green house?
Is it harmful to the environment?

ar: عمل الطلاب مع الأساتذة وشاركوا في التصميم والبناء.
en: The students worked with professors to design and build the house.
questions: Who helped the students?
Did they work alone?

ar: المنزل صغير لكنه مريح جداً ويضم غرفتي نوم.
en: The house is small but very comfortable and has two bedrooms.
questions: How many bedrooms are in the house?
Is the house comfortable?

ar: تم وضع المطبخ وغرفة الطعام والجلوس بجانب بعضها.
en: The kitchen, dining area, and living room are next to each other.
questions: Are the rooms connected or separate?
Is the layout open?

ar: المنزل يستخدم ألواح شمسية لتوليد الكهرباء والماء الساخن.
en: The house uses solar panels to generate electricity and hot water.
questions: What do solar panels produce?
Does the house need outside electricity?

ar: هناك حديقة صغيرة داخل المنزل لزراعة الخضروات.
en: There is a small indoor garden to grow vegetables.
questions: What is grown inside the house?
Can students learn from the garden?

ar: يعيش طلاب الجامعة في هذا المنزل اليوم ويهتمون بتوفير الطاقة.
en: University students live in the house today and care about saving energy.
questions: Who lives in the house now?
Do they care about energy saving?
